clinic.name: EZ Dental Clinic
clinic.tagline: Crafting Smiles as Unique as You Are
clinic.heroSubtitle: Restore your smile, regain full chewing function, and enjoy lasting confidence with comprehensive full mouth restoration at EZ Dental Clinic. Our advanced treatments, including dental implants and prosthetics, are tailored to your unique needs, offering a permanent solution for extensive dental wear, damage, or loss. With an in-house lab, we streamline your treatment process, ensuring efficient and precise results.

differentiators.description: Utilizing our state-of-the-art on-site dental laboratory, we streamline treatment, reduce wait times, and deliver faster, more precise results.

differentiators.title: Personalized Care
differentiators.description: Every patient is treated as a unique individual with distinct needs, ensuring tailored and respectful care like family.

differentiators.title: Prosthodontic Expertise

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation, including full records, CBCT scans, and photography to assess your unique needs and determine the best approach for your full mouth restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Collaborative Digital Plan
treatmentJourney.description: We develop a customized digital treatment plan with mockups of your final smile and bite, ensuring you are involved in every step and confident in the proposed outcome.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Phase
treatmentJourney.description: This phase involves necessary preparatory work such as extractions, implant placement, and any required gum or bone work, laying a strong foundation for your new smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restorations
treatmentJourney.description: Temporary restorations are placed to test your new bite, aesthetics, and function, allowing for adjustments and ensuring comfort before the final restorations are made.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Lab Fabrication
treatmentJourney.description: Utilizing our in-house lab, your final, permanent restorations are custom-fabricated with precision and artistry, ensuring a perfect fit and natural appearance, followed by delivery.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: We provide a comprehensive maintenance plan, including nightguards, regular hygiene visits, and protective care, to ensure the longevity and continued health of your full mouth restoration.

benefits.title: Enhanced Smile Aesthetics
benefits.description: Achieve a natural-looking and beautiful smile that complements your facial features.

benefits.title: Improved Oral Health

benefits.title: Long-Term Solution

benefits.title: Preserves Jawbone Integrity

implantOptions.title: Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Replace missing teeth with permanent, natural-looking restorations that restore chewing ability, jawbone health, and confidence.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Dentures
implantOptions.description: A secure alternative to traditional dentures that uses dental implants for improved stability, comfort, and function.

implantOptions.title: Dental Crowns & Bridges
implantOptions.description: Restore damaged, weakened, or missing teeth with custom-crafted restorations designed for strength, aesthetics, and long-term durability.

implantOptions.title: Porcelain Veneers
implantOptions.description: Enhance the appearance of worn, chipped, stained, or uneven teeth with thin, natural-looking porcelain shells.

implantOptions.title: Full & Partial Dentures
implantOptions.description: Replace multiple missing teeth with custom dentures that improve speech, chewing efficiency, and smile aesthetics.

implantOptions.title: Bite Reconstruction & TMJ Therapy
implantOptions.description: Correct bite misalignment, excessive tooth wear, and jaw discomfort to restore proper function and long-term oral health.

faqItems.question: How long does a full mouth restoration take?
faqItems.answer: The timeline for full mouth restoration varies depending on individual needs and the complexity of your case. Dr. Rathi will provide a detailed treatment plan and estimated timeline during your comprehensive consultation.

faqItems.question: How much does full mouth reconstruction cost?
faqItems.answer: Full mouth reconstruction is a highly personalized treatment, so costs vary. We will discuss all financial aspects during your consultation and work with most major PPO plans to maximize your benefits.

faqItems.question: Why do I need a prosthodontist instead of a general dentist for full mouth restoration?
faqItems.answer: A prosthodontist like Dr. Rathi specializes in complex dental restorations, including dental implants and full-mouth rehabilitation. Their advanced training ensures comprehensive planning and execution for optimal results in challenging cases.

faqItems.question: Will I have to be without teeth at any point during treatment?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your comfort and appearance throughout the process. During the provisional phase, we provide temporary restorations to ensure you always have a functional and aesthetic smile while your permanent ones are being crafted.

faqItems.question: How do you handle TMJ pain and bite issues?
faqItems.answer: Dr. Rathi offers TMD treatment to relieve jaw pain, headaches, and clicking joints. Addressing bite issues is a fundamental part of full mouth rehabilitation to ensure proper function and comfort.

faqItems.question: Do you offer sedation for long appointments?
faqItems.answer: While the website does not explicitly mention sedation, our patient-centered approach ensures your comfort. We encourage you to discuss any anxiety or concerns with our team during your consultation.

doctor.name: Dr. Nakul Rathi
doctor.bio: Dr. Nakul Rathi specializes in dental implants and full-mouth rehabilitation, bringing a wealth of expertise to complex cases. He pursued advanced training at New York University College of Dentistry for dental implants and completed his Master of Science and an Advanced Prosthodontics Clinical Residency Program at The Ohio State University. At OSU’s Implant Clinic, one of the oldest implant programs in the U.S., Dr. Rathi gained hands-on experience with diverse implant systems, contributing to over 25,000 implants placed. Recognized by the American Dental Association as a ‘New and Emerging Speaker,’ he teaches continuing education courses globally, lecturing on implant dentistry and CAD-CAM technology. Dr. Rathi is passionate about leveraging technology, including 3D printing and stereolithography, to enhance patient outcomes, ensuring personalized and precise care.
